svg.text: PART A - immediate generator: one mux selected by instruction_i[6:0] (opcode)
PART B - control decoder, register fields, exception logic, ID/EX pipeline register
Fig P2 - Pipeline Stage 1 (ID): immediate generator, decoder, exception logic
Follows your 'I-D stage' immediate-mux notebook page and the ID/EX block sketch. RV32M adds one decode line (funct7 = 0000001, red).
The mux picks the input whose opcode label matches (left column). 'i' = instruction_i.
ADD SUB SLL SLT SLTU XOR SRL SRA OR AND
Register fields are plain bit slices (no logic):
PC_w[31:0] from the sketch goes to the exception logic block that raises exception_pc
(shown in the sketch as the OR-ed PC path into the ID/EX register).
captures on clk; holds on stall;
sync clear to NOP on reset / flush
All outputs go to Fig P3 (operand select + ALU). Reads of rs1/rs2 use the register file (Fig P4).
